## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or workflow changes
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Build system, dependency updates, or auxiliary tools

## Phase / Scope Reference

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes locally (lint, strict type-checking, tests, contracts)
- [ ] Code formatting adheres to standards (`ruff format` / `prettier`)
- [ ] Type safety verified (`mypy --strict` / `tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Test coverage threshold met (>= 85% on backend)
- [ ] Conventional Commit messages used for all commits
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, tokens, or untracked local artifacts committed
